title: Frozen incident feedback pilot
question: On the fixed synthetic incident corpus, what correctness, safety, abstention and resource differences arise from host-controlled assessment/revision compared with one-pass generation and budget-matched resampling?

scope.system_or_population: One pinned model through MAS host, 12 authored cases in six diagnostic families
scope.conditions: No tools, no remediation, fresh independent host runs, fixed prompts and four-call upper budget
scope.spatial_scope: Local runner or manually dispatched GitHub runner
scope.temporal_scope: Three repeated trials per incident and arm in one frozen run
exclusions: Inference that agreement among model judges proves correctness

claims.statement: The pilot can estimate descriptive differences on this fixed incident corpus and reveal procedural failures.
claims.scope_limit: Synthetic authored incidents only; no promotion or production benefit claim
claims.success_consequence: Use observed discordance, failure rates and costs to plan an independently validated principal study
claims.failure_consequence: Repair measurement or workflow before proposing principal evaluation

assumptions.statement: Reference labels correctly encode the bounded evidence and unsafe-action rules.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Known-answer unit cases verify scoring; independent domain adjudication remains required.

assumptions.statement: Family averages can be treated as independent bounded observations for the illustrative interval.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Report conditional bounds and no production sampling inference.

constructs.name: Bounded incident output quality and resource use
constructs.definition: Exact diagnosis label; predefined hazardous proposals; required abstention; provider tokens and elapsed time
constructs.scope: Structured outputs for the retained synthetic cases
validity_evidence: Labels follow the authored public evidence; adversarial scorer checks are executable.

measurements.observable: Selected structured candidate, provider usage, complete call history, local timestamps
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: run.py measure, usage_from and summarise; independent answers.json
measurements.scale_or_units: Three binary outcomes, tokens, estimated USD, seconds and missing-output indicator
measurements.timing: Outcome scoring after every provider invocation is complete; no labels sent to workers
measurements.preprocessing: Average repeats and variants within diagnostic family; no output exclusions
measurements.calibration: test_run.py correct, wrong, hazardous, ambiguous and missing cases
measurements.reliability: Deterministic scoring; model stochastic variation estimated with three repeats
measurements.validity: Correctness is exact label agreement under authored scenario truth; unsafe means fixed prohibited action or absent readiness-path precondition
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same scorer and answer record for all arms
measurements.reactivity: Independent scoring cannot alter a completed generation or critique
measurements.error_model: Provider failures retained; unavailable usage/cost stays null; model critic score is not an outcome
measurements.blinding: Generating and critic workers receive evidence without case-family names or answer labels; deterministic scorer ignores arm

design.rationale: Paired arms compare complete feedback workflow against first output and equally capped unconditioned samples.
design.setting: Synthetic incident pilot using real host/provider path
design.temporal_structure: Three repeats, fresh context, no cross-run learning
design.assignment_method: Every case receives all arms; order shuffled by seed 20261016 within case/repeat
design.allocation_concealment: Freeze complete job list before calls
design.masking: Reference answers never enter workers; scoring omits arm
design.comparator: One-pass versus host revision versus four-sample fixed-last selection

units.experimental_unit: Case by repetition by arm fresh host invocation
units.observational_unit: Selected candidate and every provider invocation
inclusion_criteria: Every held-out case, every repeat, every arm including failures
units.recruitment_or_selection: Purposive six-family coverage; two distinct variants per family

interventions_or_exposures.description: One assessment-driven revision under host controller
interventions_or_exposures.target: Candidate defects detected in critic feedback
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: Draft, critique, revision, final critique; at most four provider calls
interventions_or_exposures.timing: One bounded run with fixed 180 second deadline
manipulation_checks: Retained contexts prove exact feedback supplied to revision
off_target_checks: Report evaluator cost and wall time; no side-effect tools
recovery_checks: Completed jobs reused; unknown effects not retried under new identity

controls.description: Four unconditioned generations; select the last completed index under frozen rule
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Improvement from additional sampling or call budget rather than supplied feedback
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Revision must outperform resampling before any principal study can support a feedback-specific practical benefit

confounds.description: Provider model drift or shared service load
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Calendar order may change quality or latency across arms
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Pin model identifier and randomise arm order within each case/repeat
confounds.diagnostic: Retain returned model identity and timestamps
confounds.residual_risk: Provider implementation drift not fully controlled

estimands.summary_measure: Paired family-average differences in diagnosis, unsafe proposals and appropriate abstention; total cost and mean latency
estimands.interpretation: Workflow-level differences within the pilot; no learning or mechanism attribution

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: Shared frozen incident and model; arms differ in feedback and call allocation; later independent scoring uses withheld references.
identified_parameters: Fixed-corpus descriptive quality contrasts conditional on reference validity
nonidentified_alternatives: Pure feedback mediator effect separated from differing input-token costs
diagnostics: Pinned model identifier, retained exact inputs and usage; opaque case IDs
rescue_actions: Independent adjudication and prospective production-derived cases for a new principal protocol

sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: 12 incidents, six families, three repeats, three arms, at most 324 model calls
inputs: No prior empirical discordance or cost estimates available
sampling.dependence_structure: Repeats and variants clustered within family; six units for uncertainty
sampling.multiplicity: Six paired binary contrasts with Bonferroni/Hoeffding union bound
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Retain failed/missing rows; no successful-only analysis
sampling.result: Six-family bound radius exceeds one; principal precision is unestablished.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Compare analytic radii for six and twelve families; no inflated independent count from repeats.
sampling.stopping_implications: Fixed jobs and fixed per-arm caps; no effect-dependent extension

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Hashes bind plan, corpus, answers, scorer, prompts, executable and bundle before execution
analysis.exclusion_lock: Only predeclared development split excluded; failures retained

models.model_or_procedure: Family paired means with radius sqrt(2 log(12/alpha)/n), clipped to [-1,1]
diagnostics: No replacement of families with repeats; failure and pricing completeness overrides

analysis.uncertainty: Simultaneous conservative Hoeffding intervals conditional on family independence; descriptive fixed-corpus estimates primary
analysis.multiplicity: Alpha 0.05 over two comparators and three binary outcomes
analysis.missing_data: Missing output quality=0, missing_output=1, no actual proposal unsafe=0; any missing/failure vetoes promotion
analysis.stopping_rule: All frozen jobs once, no renewed call/deadline budget on replay
robustness_checks: Report counts by family; principal design must obtain external ground truth validation
software_and_versions: Python >=3.11 standard library; immutable MAS host SHA256
analysis.inconclusive_handling: All pilot results remain descriptive; absent usage or price prevents cost inference

decision_matrix.observation_region: Completed live data with valid outcome measurements
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report estimates; use pilot nuisance information to design new principal study regardless of favourable observed effect

claim_effects.scope_limit: No production or principal efficacy claim

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Any failed reference-validation or incomplete data overrides nominal benefit
decision_matrix.next_action: Independently adjudicate fresh cases; determine allocation using nuisance estimates, not observed treatment gain

decision_matrix.observation_region: Fixture, missing output, invalid measurement, incomplete usage or unanticipated failure
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report rehearsal or unresolved pilot; promotion=false

claim_effects.rationale: These observations cannot establish empirical benefit

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Suspend affected conclusions; retain all raw records
decision_matrix.next_action: Repair demonstrated failure or collect independently validated live evidence

researcher_degrees_of_freedom: All mutable scientific inputs fingerprinted before calls
negative_controls: Fixture always abstains and never demonstrates manufactured feedback gains
falsification_checks: Changing withheld labels cannot alter provider projection
reporting_controls: Publish failed and inconclusive outcomes and all invocation costs

ethics_and_safety.rationale: Synthetic non-personal incidents with no operational tools
mitigations: No remediation or mutable external systems; fixed call/token/deadline caps
monitoring: Every effect and provider usage retained
post_stop_actions: Retain state; do not replay unknown effects under new identities

feasibility.access: Fixture local; live key only in authorised GitHub environment or user execution
resources: At most 324 calls, max 2048 output tokens each
dependencies: Built pinned host and permitted model account
blockers: Principal study adequacy and reference validation absent

reproducibility.registration: Local content-addressed freeze; not external preregistration
reproducibility.data_plan: Retain lock, job records, raw inputs, observations and report in run directory
reproducibility.randomisation_or_seed_plan: 20261016 order seed; provider randomness not seed-controlled
reproducibility.provenance_plan: Exact model, provider metadata, prompts, inputs, hashes and timestamps
reproducibility.deviation_and_amendment_plan: Any changed source requires new freeze; no post-outcome silent update
reproducibility.replication_plan: Repeat fresh run; generalisation requires new independently sourced corpus

sources: Hoeffding (1963), Probability Inequalities for Sums of Bounded Random Variables; https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.1963.10500830
change_log: 1.0.0: specified pilot, no empirical efficacy claim

method_selection.rationale: Unknown measurement adequacy, model failure/cost and paired discordance prevent a justified principal experiment.
method_selection.inference_framework: Descriptive fixed-corpus pilot with conditional finite-sample bounds
alternatives_considered: Immediate efficacy claim rejected for invalid outcome validation and insufficient independent families
More repeats rejected as substitute for independent cases

sources.citation: Hoeffding (1963), Probability Inequalities for Sums of Bounded Random Variables
sources.design_consequence: Bound paired family differences in [-1,1] without treating repeats as independent cases.
Treat resource-constrained pilot as pilot; do not imply adequate efficacy precision.

method_selection.information_criterion: Seek usable nuisance and feasibility observations, retain failed principal precision assessment
permitted_conclusions: Fixed-corpus descriptive differences and workflow feasibility
excluded_conclusions: A higher model critic score proves improvement
method_selection.discovery_confirmation_separation: Development split excluded; pilot remains separate from fresh principal corpus

collection.failure_response: Retain failure, report inconclusive, no promotion

scoring.procedure: measure against withheld answers after generation
scoring.failure_response: Retain failure, report inconclusive, no promotion

analysis.procedure: family means and conservative simultaneous bounds
analysis.failure_response: Retain failure, report inconclusive, no promotion

design_assessment.decision_use: Show pilot cannot support principal precision; plan next allocation using nuisance information
design_assessment.effect_or_precision_basis: Provisional 0.10 absolute quality-difference half-width; promotion margins in plan.json are design assumptions, not validated business tolerances.
design_assessment.pilot_basis: No live nuisance observations; six purposively authored diagnostic families

candidate_designs.allocation: Six families, two cases each, three repeats, three arms
Twelve families, two cases each, three repeats, three arms

design_assessment.selection_rationale: Choose bounded pilot only; neither candidate establishes principal precision. More case families, validated labels and calibrated inference required.
design_assessment.scenario_coverage: Distribution-free bound covers null, benefit, harm and all bounded family distributions conditional on independence.

scenarios.description: Worst-case independent paired family differences in [-1,1]

targets.rationale: Provisional precision useful for a principal quality comparison; not attainable in pilot
